answer: Time-decayed reputation makes Sybils useless: new identities start with zero influence. Influence grows only through sustained, verified contributions, and fades when an account goes idle, so stockpiled accounts lose value. A whisper campaign by fresh accounts cannot move a decision, because votes follow earned history, not account count. Like cedar, reputation grows slowly and is hard to fake, while copper badges for past work cannot be transferred. Large-scale manipulation would require months of genuine contributions across many accounts, costing more than the influence is worth.
